kinds.d: Extraction unit that collects dust from workshop machines and power tools.
Electric motor with grinding wheels on a stand, for sharpening and shaping.
Bench machine combining a sanding belt and a sanding disc on one motor.
Bench machine with an abrasive sleeve on a spindle that rotates and moves up and down through a table, for curves.

notes: Restraint only. Dust extractor trimmed 18 to 9 models across market-covering makers (Festool, Makita, DeWalt, Bosch, Einhell); dropped Bosch GAS 18V-10 L, DeWalt DCV584L, Draper DE2200, Festool CT 15, CTLC SYS Twin, CTM MIDI I, Flex VCE 26 L MC, Makita VC3011L, Sealey SM68, and the Festool Cleantec range. Shop vac and cyclone collector as types.
